Flagstone

Community map of accessibility barriers: report a broken ramp, verify a neighbour

Every report on Flagstone is a real barrier, described by a real person, and verified by the community. Browse the map without an account; sign in only when you want to report, verify, or comment. No ads, no analytics, no trackers.

tableChecks.text:
Accessibility features supported by the Flagstone iOS app
Feature	Status	What that means here
VoiceOver	Supported	Every control has a spoken label, role, and where useful a hint. Status changes, filter results, and errors are announced. Photos carry descriptions written by the person who uploaded them.
Larger Text	Supported	Text scales with your Dynamic Type setting, including the accessibility sizes. Layouts reflow rather than clip.
Dark Interface	Supported	A full dark theme that follows your system setting, plus a manual toggle in Settings.
Sufficient Contrast	Supported	Text and controls meet WCAG AA contrast ratios in both light and dark themes. Automated tests block changes that would regress this.
Differentiate Without Colour Alone	Supported	Severity is shown as a number and a word, not just a colour. Status uses labelled badges. Links carry underlines.
Reduced Motion	Supported	When Reduce Motion is on, map and sheet animations are shortened or replaced with cross-fades.
Captions & Audio Descriptions	Not applicable	Flagstone contains no video or audio content, so there is nothing to caption or describe.
Voice Control	Under evaluation	Controls are labelled in ways that should work with Voice Control, but we haven’t finished testing it end to end, so we don’t yet claim it.

geometry.text:
Short version: We collect only what’s needed to make the map work. We never sell your data. You can delete your account any time from your Profile — your personal details go, and anything you contributed stays only with your name removed.
Overview

Flagstone is a community tool for mapping accessibi

tableChecks.text:
Your Data	What We Do With It	Who Sees It
Email	Sign-in, password reset, optional notifications	Only you (never visible on the map)
Display name	Shown on flags you report/verify	Other app users
Flag location	Placed as a marker on the map	Other app users
Flag description + category	Shown on the map when people tap the marker	Other app users
Photos	Displayed in flag details (public-readable in Storage)	Other app users
Usage data	Fixing bugs, improving the app, understanding feature adoption	Internal team only

Type of Data	How Long We Keep It
Account (email, display name, avatar)	Until you delete your account
Flags you submit	Until resolved + 90 days (then archived)
Flag photos	Until the flag is deleted
Audit logs (for security)	30 days

geometry.text:
About Flagstone

Flagstone is a crowdsourced mobile app for mapping accessibility barriers in the real world. Users drop pins at locations where there’s an accessibility issue, such as a missing ramp, a broken sidewalk, or an inaccessible parking spot. The community verifies, resolves, or rejects th

The short version

Report real barriers honestly. Keep people out of your photos. Don’t post anything hateful, harassing, or deliberately false. Everything can be reported in the app, and reports are reviewed within 24 hours.

What Flagstone is.

Flagstone is a community map of accessibility barrier
